integrity: The infinite statement is proved algebraically. The bundled computation is a finite exact cross-check only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to full-support signals and even step order L>=4. The order-two case and signals with zeros are not classified. Originality assessment cannot exclude unindexed or differently phrased prior work.
title: Exact nonvanishing phase-retrieval fibers for an even two-point cyclic STFT window
